title: Studio: zh-CN first screens stop mixing English: the clone notice, the new package form, the flow rail group
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ② filed on the maintainer's word in direct chat with the epic PM seat, 2026-11-03: 「第二批也立卡」. Priority on 「相关卡 p1, 让车道处理」. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: `domain:ui`; the clone notice's string is in `packages/runtime`, so the claim states how it is translated.
Dedupe: `zh-CN English notice`, `Human-readable package name`. #29675 is a separate read fault. **New.**
type: enhancement

**Business reason.** These are among the first things a Chinese-speaking builder sees. A mixed screen reads as unfinished, and it makes it unclear which words are safe to ignore.

## What happens

| where | what | status |
|:--|:--|:--|
| New similar on a flow | the banner's second sentence, "The copy is switched off and does not run until you switch it on…", renders in English in zh-CN. The source is a server string, `packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts:191` | measured by screenshot at `3482f3d8d2` |
| New package form | labels such as Display name and Human-readable package name under a zh title. `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts:674` has that text as a `describe` | reported by an independent review; re-measure |
| Automations rail | a draft object's flow group reads `REPAIRS_REPAIR_TICKET`, its machine name uppercased | reported by the review; re-measure |
| Column picker | system fields listed before the builder's own | reported by the review; re-measure |

The #29650 refusal sentence is also English, but it goes away with that fix.

## Direction

- A sentence the server sends for a person to read has a translation path, or is sent as a code the console translates. Pick the existing pattern; state it in the PR.
- The form's labels come from the i18n catalog, not from spec `describe` text.
- A group is labelled with the object's label.
- The builder's own fields sort first.

Drop any row that does not reproduce, and say so on the card.

Links back: #29690, #29650.
